text: QTerminals was set up by Qatar Ports Management Company (Mwani Qatar), which holds 51 percent, and Qatar Navigation (Milaha), which holds 49 percent. Ship Technology describes Mwani Qatar as state-owned, and when the agreement was signed in 2016 Qatar's Minister of Transport and Communications chaired Mwani Qatar.
short: QTerminals is 51% owned by Mwani Qatar, Qatar's state-owned ports company, and 49% by Milaha.

source.name: QTerminals: About Us
source.quote: QTerminals is a terminal operating company jointly established by Qatar Ports Management Company (Mwani Qatar – 51% shareholding) and Qatar Navigation (Milaha – 49% shareholding)
